name: FFS_APPLICATION
description: Contains applications to be used to access API.

columns.name: APP_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the application.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Application name. Used as application label for binding application with plugins, properties, etc.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Application status. Possible values - 'active', 'inactive'.

columns.name: CLIENT_ID
columns.description: Application ID. Used as username in HTTP Basic auth.

columns.name: CLIENT_SECRET
columns.description: Application secret. Used as password in HTTP Basic auth.

columns.name: REALM
columns.description: All applications migrated from user types or newly created ones belong to customer realm. Internal realm is reserved for OFSC built-in services, for example Mobility Position Upload.

columns.name: TOKEN_SERVICE
columns.description: Which token service is used to get access tokens for the application to auth.

columns.name: ACCESS_TOKEN_CERT
columns.description: X.509 certificate used by OFSC token service to authenticate external IdP (IdP public key).

columns.name: ASSERTION_CERT
columns.description: X.509 certificate used by OFSC API to authenticate application (application public key).

columns.name: TOKEN_EXPIRE_TIME
columns.description: Seconds. Tokens issued using this app, will expire after this time.

columns.name: DISPLAY_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: FK display_profile.profile_id. Define application layouts.

columns.name: WHITE_LIST
columns.description: Restrict the list of IP adressess from which application is allowed to auth in OFSC. If empty - allow access from any IP. Same format as login_policy.white_list. Newline-separated list.

columns.name: APPLICATION_COMMENT
columns.description: Optional comment which describes the purpose of the application.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: FK security_user.uid. Internal user used by application for the puprose of logging.

columns.name: CORS_DOMAIN_LIST
columns.description: Contains list of domain names separated by newline.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
